description: This file implements a profitability analysis report for an ERP system, including data retrieval, calculation, and formatting functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns and data for the profitability analysis report.

methods.name: get_accounts_data
methods.description: Retrieves account data based on the 'based_on' filter and company.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Processes account data and filters to produce report data.

methods.name: calculate_values
methods.description: Calculates income, expense, and gross profit/loss for each account.

methods.name: accumulate_values_into_parents
methods.description: Aggregates values from child accounts into parent accounts.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the final report data rows, including handling distributed cost centers.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report display.

methods.name: set_gl_entries_by_account
methods.description: Fetches GL entries for accounts within date range, considering options like closing entries.
